setup:

import os, signal, socket, sys

hits = 0

def stop(*_):
    raise SystemExit

signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
server = socket.socket()
server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
server.listen(8)
server.settimeout(float(sys.argv[1]))
print(server.getsockname()[1], os.getpid(), flush=True)
try:
    while True:
        conn, _ = server.accept()
        hits += 1
        conn.close()
except (SystemExit, socket.timeout):
    pass
finally:
    print("hits=%d" % hits, flush=True)
' 60)

setup:
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'case "$1" in -m) echo x86_64 ;; *) echo Linux ;; esac' > "$T/shim/uname"
chmod 755 "$T/shim/uname"
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then SHA="sha256sum"; else SHA="shasum -a 256"; fi

printf '%s\n' 'port=$(cat "$T/mock.port" 2>/dev/null) || { echo "no-mock-port" >> "$T/curl-refused.log"; exit 7; }' 'n=$#; i=0' 'while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]; do' '  a=$1; shift' '  case "$a" in' '    https://github.com/Kewton/CommandAgent/releases/download/*)' '      a="http://127.0.0.1:$port/download/${a#https://github.com/Kewton/CommandAgent/releases/download/}" ;;' '    https://api.github.com/repos/Kewton/CommandAgent/*)' '      a="http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/${a#https://api.github.com/repos/Kewton/CommandAgent/}" ;;' '    http://*|https://*) echo "$a" >> "$T/curl-refused.log"; exit 7 ;;' '  esac' '  set -- "$@" "$a"; i=$((i + 1))' 'done' 'exec "$real_curl" --max-time 20 "$@"' >> "$T/shim/curl"

exec 3< <(python3 -I -c '
import http.server, os, signal, sys, time

root = os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1])
log = sys.argv[2]
deadline = float(sys.argv[3])
requests = 0

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        global requests
        requests += 1
        rel = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].lstrip("/")
        full = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(root, rel))
        found = full.startswith(root + os.sep) and os.path.isfile(full)
        with open(log, "a") as fh:
            fh.write("GET /%s %d\n" % (rel, 200 if found else 404))
        if not found:
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        with open(full, "rb") as fh:
            body = fh.read()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

def stop(*_):
    raise SystemExit

signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
print(server.server_address[1], os.getpid(), flush=True)
end = time.monotonic() + deadline
try:
    while time.monotonic() < end:
        server.timeout = max(0.1, end - time.monotonic())
        server.handle_request()
except SystemExit:
    pass
finally:
    print("requests=%d" % requests, flush=True)
' "$T/release" "$T/mock-requests.log" 60)
read -r -t 20 -u 3 PORT MPID || { echo MOCK_NOT_READY; exit 1; }
